Student used TRIM function which the rubric explicitly accepts for removing spaces. While TRIM only removes leading/trailing spaces (not all internal spaces), the rubric description states 'SUBSTITUTE / TRIM (accepted)'.
Student provided a formula, so the 'Nothing' criterion does not apply.
Student used LEN function in formula =LEN("Life Science"), demonstrating use of the LEN function.
